# Philips Hue (`hue`)

Lights on a Philips Hue Bridge, through the bridge's local API: power, brightness and colour. Paired with the bridge's link button; the Hue cloud is never used.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/hue`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/hue/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/hue/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `bridge`, `light` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- HTTP to the device, port 80
- HTTPS to the device, port 443

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

| `url` | Bridge address | URL (http, https) | yes |  | The bridge's address on your network, such as http://192.0.2.10: a scheme, a host and a port, and no path. |
